arc.energy_shape_notes: Two rise->peak->annihilation arches, second bigger. Loudest apex at ~56% runtime (8:00, -4.6dB RMS) is NOT the emotional climax: 17.6dB cliff to -22.2dB within 15s follows it. Emotional climax is the finale: 95s of sustained sub-bass darkness (-7.8dB), then three-stage lowpass execution and a hard stop at 14:21.4 with no fade. Climaxes escalate in darkness: loudest / longest (3.6min stutter-groove, ~17 dips) / darkest.

harmony.home_scale: F Aeolian (F G Ab Bb C Db Eb); tonic F abandoned after ~5:30 and never returns; piece ends on VII refusing resolution
signature_devices: Third-toggle vamp: static root, alternate major/minor 3rd on ~13s cycle (here Db with E<->F). Tension via third-ambiguity, not functional motion.
bVI tonicization: drift from i to bVI (Db) until the borrowed VI becomes the new home.
Pedal stasis: Db-minor ostinato over Ab pedal, 3rd often absent (root+5th power sonority).
No raised leading tone, no V-i cadences, no secondary dominants - never resolve.
Four-on-the-floor kick at 143.6 with hardgroove feel; no backbeat on 2-and-4 ever.
Straight offbeat-16th hats, no swing, grid-locked, dry (no reverb tails).
3:2 polyrhythm only in peaks: triplet-8th layer at 1.5x kick rate over the four-floor.
Rolling sub-bass pickups swell into downbeats - bass acts as percussion pushing toward the 1.
Arrhythmic breakdown: pulse dissolves (not half-time); grid returns violently.
Self-eating drop: full slam then immediate collapse into a valley within bars (not a breakdown - a failed drop).
12+ hard cuts 0.2-0.5s; deepest silences placed immediately after loudest sections.

tempo.feel: hardgroove four-on-the-floor, grid-locked, no swing; zero backbeat anywhere (no 2-and-4). 3:2 polyrhythm in peak sections: triplet-8th layer at ~215/min against the 143.6 kick. Breakdown drops the grid entirely (arrhythmic, not half-time). Finale runs a real ~8 BPM accelerando to ~152 with the low end doubling to an 8th-note pump.

timbre.palette_notes: Two 'artificial instruments': (a) near-white digital noise bursts (flatness 0.25-0.38, ZCR up to 0.505, centroid 5300-5700Hz) - 'digital shrapnel', ~1 burst/0.5s in breakdowns; (b) near-sine sub oscillators 29-117Hz carrying the last 3 minutes (finale: 99.6% energy <200Hz, 0% >4kHz). Sub GLIDES like an 808 line (A#0-A#2), not a drone. Subtractive + noise only, no FM, no reverb. Near-mono mix (L/R corr 0.85-0.99); only noise gets stereo width. Limiter pinned at 0dBFS ~47% of time as an instrument; master never clips - loudness managed, not crushed.
